differences: Text B says the spell has no spell effects, but the whole card's spell draws two cards. Text B omits that effect, and this is a sorcery, so every effect must be given.
Text B says jump-start is paid by paying {3}{U} and discarding a card rather than paying the mana cost. Jump-start is in addition to paying the card's mana cost, not instead of it.
Text B says the card is exiled only when it resolves. Jump-start exiles the card after it leaves the stack by any means, such as being countered.
